issues.legal_issue: Enhanced compensation for acquired land must be distributed according to the respective entitlements of the owner and tenants rather than paid entirely to the owner.
material_facts: The Land Acquisition Officer fixed compensation and apportioned it between the landowner and tenants whose claims were recognized.
A reference seeking increased compensation resulted in an enhanced rate, but the District Judge directed that the increased compensation be paid entirely to the landowner.
The High Court deleted that direction, and tenants were found to have been on the land when the acquisition notification was issued.
issues.conclusion: The entire enhanced compensation was not payable to the landowner. The Collector must pay her the share due to her, determine the shares due to tenants who were on the land when the notification was issued, and pay them those shares. The appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: A reference under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act does not determine apportionment. Where tenants have recognized claims and were on the land on the date of the notification, the Collector must determine their entitlement and distribute compensation accordingly, rather than paying the entire enhanced amount to the landowner. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_appeal and compensation_enhanced and tenant_claims_recognized and tenants_on_land_at_notification

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning compensation for acquired land.
predicates.compensation_enhanced: The compensation for the acquired land was increased after the initial award.
predicates.tenant_claims_recognized: The claims of tenants to a share of the compensation were recognized.
predicates.tenants_on_land_at_notification: The tenants were on the land when the acquisition notification was issued.
predicates.collector_must_distribute_compensation_b: The Collector must pay the owner only the share due to the owner and determine and pay the shares due to qualifying tenants.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns enhanced compensation for acquired land and recognized tenants were on the land at notification, the Collector must distribute the compensation according to the respective entitlements of the owner and those tenants.
